Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 29fe3a61bcdce398ee3955101c39f89c01a8a77e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Minwoo Ra <raminwo0202@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 00:58:44 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] xfrm: prevent policy_hthresh.work from racing with netns
 teardown

A XFRM_MSG_NEWSPDINFO request can queue the per-net work item
policy_hthresh.work onto the system workqueue.

The queued callback, xfrm_hash_rebuild(), retrieves the enclosing
struct net via container_of(). If the net namespace is torn down
before that work runs, the associated struct net may already have
been freed, and xfrm_hash_rebuild() may then dereference stale memory.

xfrm_policy_fini() already flushes policy_hash_work during teardown,
but it does not synchronize policy_hthresh.work.

Synchronize policy_hthresh.work in xfrm_policy_fini() as well, so the
queued work cannot outlive the net namespace teardown and access a
freed struct net.

Fixes: 880a6fab8f6b ("xfrm: configure policy hash table thresholds by netlink")
Signed-off-by: Minwoo Ra <raminwo0202@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>

diff --git a/net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c b/net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c
index 66ac93e65264..2140ee7b102d 100644
--- a/net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c
+++ b/net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c
@@ -4282,6 +4282,8 @@ static void xfrm_policy_fini(struct net *net)
 	unsigned int sz;
 	int dir;
 
+	disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work);
+
 	flush_work(&net->xfrm.policy_hash_work);
 #ifdef CONFIG_XFRM_SUB_POLICY
 	xfrm_policy_flush(net, XFRM_POLICY_TYPE_SUB, false);
-- 
2.34.1

#### Summary of Modifications

**File modified: `net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c`**

- **Added**: A call to `disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work)` inside the function `xfrm_policy_fini`, placed **before** the existing `flush_work(&net->xfrm.policy_hash_work)`.

**Relationship between modifications:**

- The existing code in `xfrm_policy_fini` already flushed `policy_hash_work` to prevent it from outliving the network namespace.
- The added line synchronizes the previously unhandled `policy_hthresh.work` work item in the same teardown path. Both work items are per-net data (embedded in `struct net`) and can be queued from XFRM netlink operations (`XFRM_MSG_NEWSPDINFO` for `policy_hthresh.work`). Without this fix, `policy_hthresh.work` could still run after the net namespace is freed, causing a use-after-free when the callback (`xfrm_hash_rebuild`) dereferences the enclosing `struct net` via `container_of()`.

**Net effect:** The patch ensures both work items are properly cleaned up during netns teardown, eliminating the race condition between workqueue execution and namespace destruction.

</text>

</text>
Reason:
The work item policy_hthresh.work, whose callback xfrm_hash_rebuild() retrieves the enclosing struct net via container_of(), is queued onto the system workqueue. During net namespace teardown, xfrm_policy_fini() does not synchronize this work, so it may run after the corresponding struct net is freed, causing a use-after-free.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>
disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work);
</text>
Reason:
Adding disable_work_sync() before the net's resources are released ensures that any pending or currently executing policy_hthresh.work is completed or canceled, preventing it from accessing the freed struct net.
